effect.name: Swirl
effect.description: Twists the image around a point, hardest in the middle and fading to nothing at the edge of its radius. Portals, whirlpools, drains, and a very good "sucked into the pipe" transition.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Centre X
parameter.description: Centre of the twist across the object.

parameter.name: Centre Y
parameter.description: Centre of the twist down the object.

parameter.name: Angle
parameter.description: Degrees of twist at the centre.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: How far the twist reaches, where 1 is half the object's width.

parameter.name: Clip Edges
parameter.description: On hides pixels dragged in from outside the object's image.
